skeleton_text: MATCH (me:HOLE_LABEL_0 {name:HOLE_LABEL_1})-[:HOLE_LABEL_2*HOLE_NUM_0]-(friendOfFriend:HOLE_LABEL_3) WHERE NOT (me)-[:HOLE_LABEL_4]-(friendOfFriend) AND me <> friendOfFriend RETURN friendOfFriend.HOLE_PROP_0 as suggestedFriend, count(friendOfFriend) as friendsInCommon ORDER BY friendsInCommon DESC
